Trusted by more than 2,300 global organizations, our platform delivers visibility, security policy management, risk reduction, and compliance automation across complex enterprise networks. As we continue to expand our cloud and enterprise business globally, we are looking for a high-impact AlgoSec Resident Engineer to join our Sales team and work with EMEA-based customers, primarily from Germany. This is an opportunity to join a profitable, growing cybersecurity company with strong market traction, a collaborative culture, and significant growth potential. Reporting to: AlgoSec Resident Engineers Manager Location: Germany (Home Office) Direct employment What You’ll Do Consult customers with best practices as a 'Trusted Advisor'. Identify trends in customer technical landscape, org structures, or priorities, and escalate key insights to internal teams. Collaborate cross-functional with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and Channel teams to deliver customer impact. Experience with networking devices (Switches, Routers etc.) Experience in firewall administration and configuration (Checkpoint, Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Palo Alto etc.) Experience working with Cloud platforms and managing Cloud Security. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English. Ability to operate under pressure in deadline-driven situations and business emergencies. Experience dealing with Global customers. Customer oriented and ability to establish customer’s trust. Problem solver, result driven, demonstrating a ‘make it happen’ attitude, attention to details. Team player, pleasant to work with, with a high level of integrity, bright, self-learner. Ability to identify and escalate revenue-driving adoption or expansion signals. Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time. Nice To Have Linux script: Perl/ Python/shell. Knowledge of APIs (Java, REST). Virtual routing and Software-defined networking. AlgoSec is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a friendly, diverse, and inclusive company culture.
